c0006.en: ▸ Print the sheet for your shift (opening or closing)

c0007.en: ▸ The shift manager assigns tasks to the team

c0008.en: ▸ Each person checks ✓ when their task is done and initials it

c0009.en: ▸ At shift end, the shift manager verifies and signs at the bottom

c0010.en: ▸ File the signed sheets — they prove the work was done, and who did it

c0012.en: ▸ Green cells are editable — change assignments and times

c0013.en: ▸ Adjust the due-by times to your real schedule

c0015.en: ▸ Mark ✓ in the "✓ Done" column (dropdown): that is the column that counts completed tasks.

c0017.en: ▸ The denominator counts the tasks written in the "Task" column, not a fixed number: if you add or delete tasks, the total adjusts by itself.

c0019.en: ▸ At the end of each table there are 5 free green rows INSIDE the range the counter covers: write your own tasks there.

c0020.en: ▸ If you need more, insert rows INSIDE the table (right-click → Insert), never below the last one: anything typed outside the range is not counted.

c0022.en: ▸ Sheets with formulas are protected WITHOUT a password: the input cells (the green ones) are unlocked, so calculations never get overwritten by accident.

c0023.en: ▸ You can insert and delete rows with protection on. To change the structure: Review → Unprotect Sheet.

c0027.en: Designed by John Guerrero — chef and restaurant consultant since 2010, in professional kitchens since age 17 · johnguerrero.es

c0089.en: Use the dropdown: ✓, — or N/A. N/A = not applicable, comes out of the total; — = not done, counts as pending.
